name: Валюты — отдельные значки (слово автора 30.09.2026: «Иконки золота, духа, Энериума и Души переделай как отдельные арты а не сетка, как и рунный ключ»). Узнаваемость прежних значков сохранена: монета, бирюзовый вихрь, синее пламя, зелёный кристалл, ключ. Вторая волна — вид придуман заново по лору (слово автора: «Вид их можешь сам придумать как ты это видишь а не ориентироваться на референс, это были заглушки»).

plan.cur-*: 1:1, 1K, ключ black (монета, кристалл, ключ) и black-glow (вихрь, пламя), по одному значку на картинку; выгрузка 256 px поверх прежних gold.png, spirit.png, souls.png, enerium.png, rune-key.png

style: Art style: dark fantasy game art for a premium mobile RPG — gloomy, ancient, rich and uneasy. Hand-painted digital painting: visible confident brush strokes, simplified planes, deep near-black shadows, crisp rim light on edges, rich material detail and masterful craftsmanship. Palette: soot black (#050607, #121518), graphite (#262B31), very dark old oak, blackened iron, aged bronze and old gold leaf that gleams softly, yellowed bone, deep teal velvet. Everything is heavy, worn by centuries of use, precious and made by a master: no cheap shine, no plastic, no clean saturated game-UI colors. Light is scarce and precious and comes from below: a cold turquoise glow of karst crystals (#48E5D4) from beneath, and a few warm amber highlights (#E6A84B). The world lies deep under the city of Endalor, in the tower of a keeper of knowledge: vast, cold, silent and dusty. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime, no cartoon, no flat vector style.
negative: No words, no letters, no digits, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no Roman numerals, no runes, glyphs or markings that look like writing, no labels, no price tags, no handwriting, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no buttons, no border or frame around the whole picture. No skulls, no skeletons, no blood, no gore. No pentagrams, no occult signs, no crosses, no religious symbols, no eyes, no faces. No people, no hands, no creatures. No candles with dripping wax. No purple or violet light, no neon. No bright polished gold, no glossy plastic shine, no clean bright mobile-game UI look.
cutout_rule: The background is one solid flat color {hex}, perfectly even from edge to edge: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no wall, no table under the object, no cast shadow, no vignette, no checkerboard. The object itself never uses this background color. Any glow stays close to the object and fades out within a short distance.

cur-solid.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply.

Format: a premium currency icon for a dark fantasy mobile RPG — one object, centered, seen straight on, upright. It floats on pitch black: everything around it is solid pure black, and an empty black margin of at least one eighth of the canvas stays on every side. It must read at a tiny size, about 20 px, in the wallet bar: one simple strong silhouette with a clear signature color, all the painterly detail inside the silhouette; no sparks, embers or particles flying away from it. A crisp rim light runs along the outline and separates it from the black.

jobs.title: Золото
jobs.source: Кошелёк: золото — каждый враг, контракты, ритуалы (CUR.gold)
jobs.subject: Two thick old gold coins of the golden age of caravans, one lying behind and above the other, slightly overlapping. The front coin is octagonal with a square hole punched through its center; around the hole a raised square rim and four small stamped tower motifs, one on each side — symbols, not writing. Bright rich saturated gold with glowing polished highlights on the edges and deep amber shadows, worn smooth by many hands. Lit only by warm golden light; no teal, green or blue light on or under the coins.

jobs.title: Дух
jobs.source: Кошелёк: дух — враги биомов, ритуалы; тратится на уровни героев (CUR.spirit)
jobs.subject: One wisp of spirit: a luminous ribbon of teal-cyan mist that coils into a tight spiral knot, with a small bright pale seed of light at the heart of the spiral and a short tail of mist trailing below, like a breath caught in the air and wound around itself. Soft glow, compact round silhouette. Signature color: teal #48E5D4 with a near-white heart.

jobs.title: Души
jobs.source: Кошелёк: души — элиты и боссы, ритуалы; за деньги — только стартовый набор (CUR.souls)
jobs.subject: One soul phial: a small teardrop-shaped vessel of clear old glass, capped at the top with a tiny dark bronze stopper and a short bronze ring. Inside the glass burns a trapped cold blue soul flame with a white-blue heart, its light filling the glass and glowing through it. Signature color: icy blue #3AA8FF. The phial stands upright; its silhouette reads as a glowing blue drop.

jobs.title: Энериум
jobs.source: Кошелёк: Энериум — донатная валюта и ресурс мастерской (CUR.enerium)
jobs.subject: One Energium crystal standing upright: a broad faceted gem, about half as wide as it is tall, pointed at the top and bottom. Vivid saturated emerald green. Inside it time has stopped: a bright green light in the shape of a tiny hourglass glows in its core, and fine grains of glowing sand hang frozen mid-fall around it inside the crystal. Crisp bright highlights on the upper facets, deep green on the shadow side. Signature color: emerald #4FDC8B. It must read at 20 px as a bold green gem.

jobs.title: Рунный ключ
jobs.source: Кошелёк: рунный ключ — вход к рунному стражу (CUR.keys)
jobs.subject: One key of the gods lying diagonally, bow at the upper right, bit at the lower left. The bow is an open ring of old gold with five short pointed rays around it, each ray tipped with a small glowing teal stone — five for the five gods. The long shaft is blackened iron wrapped with a thin band of old gold near the bow; the heavy toothed bit is iron. Thin grooves along the shaft glow with cold teal light — simple lines and notches, not letters. Signature: dark iron and old gold with teal glow.
